links.outcome: Readability of LLM TKA patient education responses (FKGL, FRES)
links.effect: DeepSeek R1 FKGL 7.5 vs ChatGPT-4o 10.2; FRES 62.3 vs 45.6 (p<0.05). ChatGPT-4o output was harder to read, above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: DeepSeek R1 produced responses with superior readability, indicated by a lower FKGL (7.5 vs. 10.2) and higher FRES (62.3 vs. 45.6) (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the performance (accuracy, comprehensiveness, readability, safety) of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek R1) in answering patient FAQs regarding total knee arthroplasty, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
